svg.text: DIMENSIONED XZ CLOSURE CROSS-SECTION: TAB TUCK, 14.5 mm HINGE RELIEF & FORCE PATHS
Front-Throat XZ Detail (x_box in [-160, -86] mm, z in [78, 148] mm):
Side-wall top z = 128.0 mm (lid seats <= 3.0 mm gap)
front_panel (0.8 mm proxy,
inner face x = -127.0 mm,
top edge z = 127.0 mm)
Seated window lid (1.6 mm proxy; LID_ANCHOR at x = +127.8, z = 128.0 mm)
TAB_ANCHOR (-124.5, 128.0) mm (2.5 mm inside front_panel inner face)
1.0 TUCKED (q_tab = -57.8 deg):
tip 30.9 mm behind x = -127.0 mm (>= 10.0 mm gate)
r = 0..14.5 mm collider relief (dashed)
0.75 UNTUCKED (+11.5 deg): distal collider
r = 14.5..35.0 mm hangs outside front_panel
Cake rosette peak z = 99.3 mm (28.7 mm clear below closed lid & tucked tab!)
Reproducible Mechanics & Force Paths:
1. Real vs Sim Tab Hinge Relief (0..14.5 mm):
In real 0.6 mm SBS board, an uncreased outward
tab bows ~2.5 mm near the lid score line so the
lid still closes flat with the tab outside (0.75).
Relieving rigid tab_boxes on r = 0..14.5 mm
(collider on r = 14.5..35.0 mm) reproduces both
0.75 (tab outside) and 1.0 (tucked >= 10 mm).
2. Estimated Crease Parameters (disclosed):
- front_panel: friction 0.026 N*m, damp 0.008
- lid: friction 0.082 N*m, hysteresis 0.085 N*m
- lid_tab: spring 0.001 N*m/rad around +45 deg,
stiction 0.008 N*m, hysteresis 0.014 N*m.
- front spring 0.4 N*m/rad below 15 deg up; gussets 0.08
3. Force Paths by Phase:
- Stage A: Left presses the sprung front panel
flat; Right pushes the 15.3 mm board rim onto it.
- Pause: Left clamps the +Y wall; Right holds.
- Stage B: Right slides board between upright
gussets (~1.1 N << ~5.0 N cake-on-board shear).
- Flap fold: Right lifts free edge 0 -> 75 deg,
then squares it; gussets fold inside the corners.
- Tab crease: Left braces lid at ~44 deg, Right
sweeps r = 26..30 mm; Left seats lid on walls
while Right guards front panel outer face.
4. Board Boundary & Release Gate:
- Analytic 3D cylinder projection <= 128.0 mm
(127.0 mm inner wall + 1.0 mm wall/ruler tol).
- All 6 pad/jaw points >= 80.0 mm clear for full
21-sample (1.0 s) < 1.0 mm 3D stillness window.
- Tab free edge >= 10.0 mm behind x = -127.0 mm.
Prospective real-trial retention check (procedure, not a pre-claimed measurement): after 1.0 s stillness with >= 80 mm ruler/gauge hand clearance,
lift the closed carton 50 mm by its side walls and tilt 30 +/- 2 deg forward against a 30 deg wedge for 3 s; front_panel and lid_tab must stay tucked.
